_comment: F13 Tidewake local chains (docs/design/WORLD.md, Tidewake - six new local chains). Each step is a host-validated record committed through the existing water_dock_action intent (scripts/world/water_local_chain_rules.gd): the host resolves the actor's identity and position, checks prerequisites and any per-character receipt, and writes world-scoped records under the declared world prefix water_claim: (water_claim:local:<chain>:<step>). Speech steps are requested by a guarded Water conversation (water_characters.json dialogue_event_guards, effect water:local_step:<id>); speech itself writes nothing. Rewards stay the existing pocket rows and their original receipts unless a step names a grant.
_comment_speech_radius: Water speech opens within 5 m of the speaker; the host allows 6 m of horizontal distance from the speaker's authored standing point for proxy/terrain slack.
_comment_site_radius: Site prompts open within 3.6 m of their prop; the host allows 4.8 m horizontally for proxy slack.

landmark_lamps._comment: Lastlight, Halen's old lamp post (water_halen_shelter_lead): the landmark row in water_world.json fixes where it stands; this is its visible prop, built by WaterLocalChains on every peer from the first frame, whatever the chain state, because the lamp is the lure. Same vocabulary as the Stormwood wayfinding lamps (stormwood_pockets.json mouth_lure/spur_marker): a bark-finished wooden post with its own static collider, the installed Quaternius wall lantern on its bracket, an unshaded amber flame and a short warm light. Its lantern faces the arrival landing (yaw toward -Z).

_comment_wayfinding_lures: F13#3 chain lures (V-TW-2..6) and F13#2 reward-pocket lures: always-standing wayfinding groups built by WaterLocalChains on every peer from the first frame, whatever the chain state. Installed Water pieces only: the Lastlight bark lamp post + Quaternius wall lantern (collides, post width), the Quaternius standing banner Banner_2 (teal/white cloth, never Team Tether red; art only) and the Water camps' own campfire (scripts/build/campfire.gd) with its smoke column raised as a signal (campfire_glow.gd configure_smoke). Offsets are world metres from at_xz; every piece is grounded at its own spot. Spots were chosen by a terrain sightline probe from the island's arrival landing and the approach stand, and kept aside from the walked chain routes (tests/smoke_tidewake_b_chain_route.gd).

wayfinding_lures._why_at: F13#3 r3: on the grass crest left of the crest tree, 41 m from the lantern_cove landing camera and 17 m north of the walked route (baked-ground plan (-291.7, 138.0)), so the banner stands near the centre of the landing frame against the pale rock and the smoke column rises against open sky, not the canopy. Round 2 had it 65 m off beside the trunk (judge: 'half-hidden behind a tree trunk', 'far, small, muted').

Beside the dry nook cache water:lantern_cove:pickup:002 (-407.7, 210.4), 4.6 m beyond it from the landing. From the mid-approach stand the site is in sight (2.3 m); from the landing the crest hides it, so the signal smoke rises past the crest (28 m).

Adair's survey marker on the west shoulder, 21 m downhill of the satchel site: the satchel's own spot is behind the hilltop from the gull_rest landing (15.5 m), this shoulder is in view from the landing and the 40 m stand.
Survey lamp and banner 3.5 m uphill-east of the satchel prompt (-22.34, 883.98), seen from the mid-approach stand and from the survey marker below.

On the walked route's climb from Otto's camp (plan point (552, 1376), 31 m from the landing camera), 3.5 m east of it, so the whole banner stands inside the landing frame beside Otto's camp; higher points of the climb leave the frame's top edge: the part of the way to the nest a player at the tidal_cradle landing can see inside the frame (the nest is 406 m on, behind the massif).

Head of the walked gully, 23 m short of the shell nest seam water:tidal_cradle:harvest:007 (818, 55, 1644) and 5 m aside from the route; the seam itself sits below a lip, this spot is in sight from the walked-route stand 100 m short (740, 1584).

F13#3 r3: on the flat sand 28 m from the drowned_garden landing camera, near the centre of the landing frame, 8 m right of the walked route (baked-ground plan (1076.3, 2250.0) to (1082.3, 2252.0)) where it bends toward the saddle; banner, lamp, an ordinary camp fire and a crate-and-barrel stack (no signal column this close: the saddle group beyond carries it). Round 2 had it in the saddle 87 m away, left of centre and low contrast (judge: 'small, off-center').

F13#3 r3: the round-2 saddle spot on the walked route (plan point (1136.3, 2274.0), 87 m from the landing camera, 4 m aside), now only the signal column (Meadows Juno treatment) and a banner: seen from the landing it rises beyond the near banner group, so the frame has one column at a distance instead of a close black wedge (r3 iteration-1 judges: 'reads as a rendering artifact' at 28 m).
Behind the exposed vault wall (1204.5, 2337.6; the wall runs along X), so banner and smoke rise over it as seen from the approach; clear of the wall's prompt side.

F13#3 r3: on the approach slope 27 m ahead of the mid-approach stand, left of the player in the frame and about 20 m aside from the walked route (plan (1166.3, 2286.0) to (1172.3, 2290.0)), with a crate-and-barrel stack at its foot so it reads as a built survey point (r3 iteration-2 judges: banners 'high and small', 'no strong focal object'); the vault wall group beyond sits behind the crest over open water (round-2 judge: 'tiny near the horizon'), so this group (banner, lamp, ordinary camp fire, crates; the vault group keeps the signal column) marks the way at a readable size.

Chart-station lamp 2.5 m beside the Deep Watch chart control (1268.3, 3413.1; WaterDocks deep_watch_chart), on the left of the walk up from the landing 13 m away, so the low table reads as a station. It stood 2.4 m beyond the chart until tb/tidewake-full: its colliding post sat on the walked line from the landing and every walk inland stalled against it.
F13#2 pocket reed_root_hollow (-101.0, 457.8): 4.5 m beyond its centre from the walked approach (plan points (-92, 444) to (-100, 456)), in sight of the 40 m lure stand (-92, 420).

F13#2 pocket brine_upper_shelf (516.4, 615.0): 4 m beyond its centre from the 40 m lure stand (493.6, 644), where the shelf is behind the grass crest (2.1 m needed at the centre); the banner and lamp clear it.
F13#2 pocket salt_bell_terrace (30.7, 2393.5): 4.5 m north of its centre, beyond the walked approach up x = 30 from the 40 m stand (30, 2352).

F13#2 pocket deep_watch_tidecoil_cache (1409.8, 3550.1) sits on a ledge 10.5 m out of sight from the 40 m lure stand (1372, 3535); this rim spot 9 m short of it is in sight (0.8 m) and 7 m aside from the walked climb (1404, 3563) to (1410, 3551).

steps.claim_refusal: Take the cache from the dry nook beneath Lantern Cove's rock arch first, then swim back to Pell.
steps.refusal: Finish the sheltered swim lesson before Pell sends you further out.
steps.message: Pell marks your Lantern Cove return line. The swim back from the arch is yours to reuse.
Adair's request: recover the survey satchel left at Gull Rest, off Reedhaven's sheltered line.

steps._why_at: Inside reward pocket gull_research_satchel (radius 5 m), 4.5 m uphill of its Skill Candy II row so the two prompts never overlap; analytic ground 24.0 m, 16 degree slope.
steps.label: Recover Adair's survey satchel
steps.refusal: Surveyor Adair has not told you about this satchel yet.
steps.message: Survey satchel recovered: Adair's current observations. Carry them back on your next Brine Steps passage.

steps.refusal: Recover the survey satchel at Gull Rest first.
steps.message: Adair charts the safe Gull Rest crossing from the recovered observations.
Otto's lead: the dry shell nest on Tidal Cradle's upper slope, with exposed Reef Stone.

steps._why_requires: The nest's own world-once Reef Stone seam (water_pickups.json water:tidal_cradle:harvest:007, pickaxe, yield 4). The stone stays with whoever mined it; the return does not pay it again.
steps._why_swimmer: WORLD: return with a legal owned swimmer (a swim-mount compatible species in the requester's party) or after declining Aquaryn (the shared trial settled, whoever caught or defeated it). Never a requirement to catch Aquaryn.
steps.refusal: Mine the Reef Stone in the shell nest on Tidal Cradle's upper slope first.
steps.swimmer_refusal: Otto would rather meet the swimmer you travel with. Bring one of your own, or come back once Aquaryn's trial is settled either way.
steps.message: Otto shares 3 berries and marks where Mosshell, Riverdrake and Sirenseal swim.
Edda's request: copy the account on the Drowned Garden's exposed vault wall and bring it to Salt Crown.

steps._why_at: Inside reward pocket garden_exposed_vault (radius 5 m), 4.5 m east of its Skill Candy II row along the slope's contour, so the 4 m wall piece sits within 0.06 m of level ground end to end; analytic ground 27.8 m, well above the sea: no diving.
steps.label: Copy the vault wall's account
steps.refusal: Shrinekeeper Edda has not asked you to record this wall yet.
steps.message: Vault wall account copied: the old dock ledgers carved before the Tether. Bring it to Edda at Salt Crown.

steps.refusal: Copy the account on the Drowned Garden's vault wall first.
steps.message: Edda adds the vault's dock account to the Salt Crown records.
Halen's request: 4 driftwood and 4 reed fiber to roof the creature bed at the landing camp beside Lastlight.

steps._why_at: The existing legal camp water_camp_veilfall (camp at [381.661, 3822.923]; its creature bed at camp + (-4, 0)). The delivery prompt stands 3.5 m west of the bed on 6.6 degree ground, so it never overlaps the bed's own assign prompt. Veilfall exterior, beside the arrival landing; nowhere near the concealed interior staging area.
steps.label: Deliver shelter timber and reed
steps._why_done_model: The camp set's own tent, raised over the creature bed as its permanent shelter once the delivery is recorded (world-visible to every peer).
steps.materials_refusal: Halen's shelter needs 4 driftwood and 4 reed fiber.
steps.refusal: Campkeeper Halen has not asked for a shelter here yet.
steps.message: The creature bed at the Veilfall camp is sheltered now. Rest a companion there.

steps._why_bed: water_camp_veilfall creature_bed_index; the record follows the existing bed rest (creature_bed.gd), before or after Venn.
steps.rest_refusal: Rest one of your companions in the sheltered bed first.
steps.message: Your companion settles in the sheltered bed. Halen will want to hear it held.
